notes: The leaf has no source folio number at its head. It has display labels (8) and (9), an inline reference to (8), and a fine marginal 9 at the bottom-left corner. No date or title occurs.

The opening paragraph continues the discussion of an arithmetical part, identifies an indexed field written with a tall K/k and subscript 0, and introduces an exact sequence. The repeated phrase de Qbar/Q after extension finie/Q is visibly present and is retained even though it is repetitive.

Display (8) contains full bar-K/K subscripts on pi and E as well as the upper Gamma term. The first horizontal link is a plain dash; subsequent links have visible heads. A hooked downward arrow connects the upper indexed Gamma term to Gamma_{Qbar/Q}. The short strokes at the upper Gamma’s top-right edge leave a possible prime uncertain, so a local Gamma/Gamma-prime doubt is retained.
The NB margin says that pi_{bar K/K}=(1) sss K alg. sur Q, i.e. fini sur Q. NB is independently underlined. This is a transcription of the writer’s assertion, not a proof check.

The next paragraph proposes to interpret the kernel and sequence by writing K as a direct limit of the finite-type Q-subalgebras A_i. The lower i beneath the direct-limit arrow in (9) is clear and is retained.

The bottom paragraph discusses affine models, a cofinal collection of regular A_i, the interlinear equivalent formulation that U_i are smooth over Q, and localizations A_i to A_j=(A_i)_{f_{ij}} with f_{ij} in A_i minus {0}. It ends with inclusions ouvertes and U_j=(U_i)_{f_{ij}}, followed by On peut. The reading was not continued beyond the physical page.

The adjacent indices in all three bottom formulas were inspected on c14, c15 and c16: A_i to A_j, the subscript f_{ij}, membership in A_i, and the final U_j=(U_i)_{f_{ij}}. The membership sign has its middle stroke; the set difference is an oblique stroke and the braces enclose 0. No changes from the agreed witness readings were required there.

The phrase i.e. les U_i lisses/Q, is a smaller interlinear addition, attached after réguliers and before avec. No deletion occurs on this page. The initial cluster before extension remains uncertain u rather than being omitted or silently expanded.
No mathematical result was independently proved, computed, refuted, or used to force a reading; checks is empty.

Independent audit: all9 differing boxes were inspected. K_0 is resolved as capital K; l’a/le and the u/opening-quotation cluster remain explicitly doubtful. Two opening ticks before lisses were added to the insertion, with no unwritten closing pair. The small angular pi is kept by comparison with its introduction on scan009; the upper Gamma prime remains doubtful. The downward hook, literal sss and i.e. are retained from their strokes.
